sentences.en: Since we got married, he's become a devoted family man.
sentences.zh: 自从我们结婚后，他就成了一个献身家庭的男人。

sentences.en: I count myself lucky to have such a devoted wife.
sentences.zh: 我感到很幸运能拥有这样一位挚爱的妻子。

sentences.en: He devoted all his time to the study of history.
sentences.zh: 他把所有的时间都奉献给了历史研究。

senses.zh: 专心的；恩爱的献身的；非常用心的
